info.title: honey master API
info.description: Stable automation surface for honey. Create a named key in Settings, store the hny_ token once, and send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>. API keys use the same owner/admin/operator/viewer permission ladder as panel accounts.

get.description: Owner role required. Plaintext tokens are never returned.

post.description: Owner role required. The token is returned exactly once.

delete.description: Owner role required. Revocation is immediate.

post.description: Operator role required. Does not change live config or processes.

200.description: Fresh credentials; sensitive values may be shown once

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive message, target, field or request_id search.

get.description: Bounded hourly/day aggregates. Protocol and transport attribution is not inferred from core counters.

get.summary: Export traffic time series as CSV

Unauthorized.description: Bearer key or panel session required

NotFound.description: Resource not found or outside caller scope

Upstream.description: Agent or managed core rejected the operation
